summary: Petrobras filed a routine Form 6-K announcing its third-quarter 2026 reporting schedule. The Brazilian integrated energy company will release its 3Q26 Production and Sales Report on October 28, 2026, and its 3Q26 Financial Results on November 10, 2026, both after market close, followed by a Portuguese-language webcast with English simultaneous translation on November 11, 2026. CFO and Investor Relations Officer Fernando Sabbi Melgarejo signed the report. No special-situation transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or structural mechanic is disclosed; the filing is an ordinary earnings-calendar notice.
